import re
with open('unpacked/word/document.xml', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    content = f.read()
# Verify each headline run now has underline
paras = re.findall(r'<w:p>.*?</w:p>', content, re.S)
headline_count = 0
for p in paras:
    texts = re.findall(r'<w:t[^>]*>([^<]*)</w:t>', p)
    text = ''.join(texts)
    if text in ('EXECUTIVE SUMMARY','FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS','REVENUE BREAKDOWN BY SEGMENT','KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS','OPERATING EXPENSES','Q1 2025 OUTLOOK','RISK FACTORS'):
        has_u = '<w:u w:val=\"single\"/>' in p
        print(f'{text}: underline={has_u}')
        headline_count += 1
print('Total headlines:', headline_count)
# Confirm body paragraphs were NOT underlined
body = content[content.find('The fourth quarter'):]
print('Body underlined:', '<w:u' in body)
